Who We Are

About Us

The Pakistan Society of Health-System Pharmacists (PSHP) is a non-commercial, non- religious and non-political society comprising of a group of professional pharmacists who are striving to build & practice professional Pharmacy Services in Pakistan to enhance the quality of health care.

Established in year 2007, PSHP has been successfully advocating & functioning providing a platform for the enhancement & growth of Pharmacy Professionals as well as Pharmacy Students. The executive body of the society includes pharmacists from various esteemed private and public organizations.

Faqs

What is PSHP?

The Pakistan Society of Health-System Pharmacists (PSHP) is a non-commercial, non- religious and non-political society who intends to empower Pharmacy profession in Pakistan.

Who can join?

PSHP provides a platform for both Pharmacy professionals as well as Pharmacy students therefore we provide two types of memberships;

  • Membership for Pharmacy Professionals
  • Membership for Pharmacy Students
Why should I join?

PSHP provides its members updated pharmacy advancements, Pharmacist capacity building, Education & Training, Career growth, Career guidance & a unique platform to interact with Pharmacy professionals all over Pakistan.

Do I have to pay for Membership?

PSHP provides a free Membership to the Pharmacists & Pharmacy students.

Can I participate in PSHP activities?

All PSHP members can actively participate & play their part in Pharmacist empowerment

Can I get any advice/guidance from the PSHP personnel?

PSHP Pharmacist pool provides their members, expert advice & guidance for professional & personal growth.

MoU Signed Between BIPS and PSHP

Baqai Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences (BIPS) and The Pakistan Society of Health-System Pharmacists (PSHP) joined hands by signing an MoU on March 9, 2023, at Baqai Medical University (BMU), Karachi.

This MoU will provide Capacity Building and Continuing Education of Pharmacists across Pakistan and will strengthen pharmacy practice in Pakistan through advocacy and best practices suggestions to the healthcare agencies.

Prof. Dr. Kashif Ikram (Pro-Vice Chancellor, BMU), Prof. Dr. Syed Fazal Hussain (Director, ORIC), Prof. Dr. Sofia Ahmed (Dean, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences), Prof. Dr. M. A. Sheraz (Director, BIPS), RPh. Sumera Khan (Chief Pharmacist, Tabba Heart Institute), and RPh. Aasma Hamid (Director of Pharmacy Services, DUHS) were present on the occasion.
President/CEO PSHP, Mr Abdul Latif Sheikh and Senior Vice President, Salwa Ahsan expressed their appreciations towards the collaboration, and stated that the MoU will surely strengthen the efforts for joint advocacy and support for PSHP’s programs in professional pharmacy practice development in Pakistan.
